title: Slovakian Stew with Bamboo Shoots
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian stew recipe featuring bamboo shoots, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the vegan broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the sliced bamboo shoots, diced carrots, and diced potatoes.
Stir in the tomato paste and season with salt and pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Enjoy your delicious and comforting Slovakian stew!
